newsitem.title: USA: NY Citizens Board says NYNEX, Bell hearings set.
newsitem.headline: NY Citizens Board says NYNEX, Bell hearings set.

text.p: The New York Citizens Utility Board said Wednesday that its application for rehearing to consider the proposed merger of NYNEX Corp and Bell Atlantic Corp has been granted by the New York State Public Service Commission.

In a release Wednesday, the group said that the commission had previously ruled that only its staff would negotiate with the companies on the merger proposal. The commission had also said that only its commissioners would cross-examine the companies' witnesses at a December 16 hearing, the group said.

After objecting to the commission's action, the group, along with a coalition of consumer groups, unions and elected officials, filed an application to open up the process by which the state considers the proposed merger.

The N.Y. Citizens Utility Board said its group and the other parties have been given full access to all settlement negotiations and the right to submit questions for the commissioners to consider asking the NYNEX and Bell Atlantic witnesses.
The N.Y. Citizens Utility Board is a non-profit citizens' group based in Albany.
